name: Pipe-Bomb
description: A self-hosted music streaming platform with a plugin system, flexible attribute schema, and an app-quality client. This is the all-in-one image — the API server, frontend, and nginx proxy all run inside a single container.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Where Pipe Bomb stores its database and core data.

paths.name: Resources Path
paths.description: Where Pipe Bomb stores resources such as album art and thumbnails.

paths.name: Audio Cache Path
paths.description: Where Pipe Bomb caches audio files. Recommended to place on a fast drive (e.g. your cache pool).

paths.name: Plugin Cache Path
paths.description: Where Pipe Bomb stores plugin-related cache files.

paths.name: Plugins Path
paths.description: Where Pipe Bomb loads plugins from.

paths.name: Temp Path
paths.description: Where Pipe Bomb writes temporary files. Can safely point to fast or ephemeral storage.

paths.name: Secrets Path
paths.description: Where Pipe Bomb stores secrets such as the JWT signing key. Keep this on persistent storage.

paths.name: Music Library Path
paths.description: Path to your local music library for the local-library plugin.

ports.name: Web Port
ports.description: Port Pipe Bomb will be accessible on.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Only needed if CORS is causing issues. Set to the exact URL you use to access Pipe Bomb (e.g. http://192.168.1.100 or http://pipebomb.local).
